model.name: folderTree.addChildInPlace
model.description: On add-child, the controller mutates the model node children and the view re-renders JUST that node via the ONE VIEW BUS — the tree does not collapse or rebuild wholesale, expanded state survives.
model.note: Architect wires the in-place-node-update Class/Method (add-child -> targeted ViewBus.notify, no full-tree render) on build-go; expert builds; tester gates member-session @390 (tree-stays-put + expanded-survives) + collapse-on-add stub.
